## Recopy v1.8.0 - Better Preview Copying and Shortcut Discovery

Recopy v1.8.0 makes text previews more flexible and keyboard workflows easier to discover. You can now copy exactly the text you select in a preview, and the new Shortcuts settings page keeps navigation and item actions in one place.

### Highlights / What's New

- Select and copy part of the content shown in plain-text, rich-text, link, and text-file previews with `Cmd/Ctrl+C`.
- Keep whole-item copying as the fallback when there is no valid preview selection.
- Discover panel navigation, item actions, and window controls in the new **Settings → Shortcuts** page.
- Configure the global Recopy shortcut from the dedicated Shortcuts page, with complete English and Chinese labels.

### Improvements

- Clear stale preview selections when switching items or closing the preview.
- Keep Recopy visible when focus moves between the main panel and preview window.
- Prevent copied preview selections from being re-added as duplicate clipboard history entries.
- Strengthen the release and updater pipeline, including automated Gitee mirror synchronization for users in mainland China.

### Downloads

| Platform | File |

| macOS Intel | `Recopy_1.8.0_x64.dmg` |
| Windows 64-bit | `Recopy_1.8.0_x64-setup.exe` |

### Notes

- **macOS:** The app is not notarized yet. On first launch: right-click → Open → confirm. See the [Installation Guide](https://github.com/shiqkuangsan/Recopy/blob/main/docs/macos-unsigned-app.md).
- Release builds passed on macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Windows x64 in GitHub Actions.
- Updater archives, signatures, and `latest.json` are included.

## Recopy v1.8.0 - 更灵活的预览复制与快捷键发现

Recopy v1.8.0 让文本预览更加灵活，也让键盘操作更容易发现。现在可以直接复制预览中选中的部分文本；新的“快捷键”设置页则集中展示导航和条目操作。

### 亮点 / 更新内容

- 支持在纯文本、富文本、链接和文本文件预览中选择部分内容，并通过 `Cmd/Ctrl+C` 精确复制。
- 没有有效预览选区时，仍保持复制完整剪贴板条目的原有行为。
- 新增 **设置 → 快捷键** 页面，集中展示面板导航、条目操作和窗口控制快捷键。
- 全局 Recopy 唤起快捷键迁移到独立的快捷键页面配置，并提供完整的中英文界面。

### 改进

- 切换条目或关闭预览时清理过期选区，避免复制旧内容。
- 在主面板和预览窗口之间切换焦点时保持 Recopy 可见。
- 避免把预览选区复制操作再次记录为重复的剪贴板历史。
- 加固发版和应用内更新链路，并为中国大陆用户增加自动化 Gitee 镜像同步。
